scope: Read-only acquisition/archive diagnostics and pre-WP06 cohort partitioning; no calibration authorization

metadata_sources.native: Persisted exact native dimension aliases only; conflicts fail closed
metadata_sources.extraction_api: Persisted product/field specifications are separate product_metadata evidence. No GRIB dimensions inferred from parameter names, interval descriptions or requested coordinates.
metadata_sources.historical: Immutable parent/field evidence and clocks remain unchanged; diagnostics never repair or relabel data

completeness: Report schema_present independently from scientifically_known. Compare existing canonical/reader labels without rewriting them.
lineage: Retain full source/member/source-set identity; never compose v5/v6 or source sets. Archive copies, ensemble members and model relatives are not independent votes.
truth: Truth join, observation representativeness, missingness selection and effective sample size require an explicitly versioned WP06 contract; absent here
replacement: whole_transaction_v1_retained; record-selective successor deferred until explicit parity, causal publication, source-set atomicity and rollback proof
